instagram.caption:
The heavy mirror you would rather not touch.
The Wall and Display Zone in the Stair Landing. The frames, mirror and any sconces on the stairway wall, hung so they stay put and never crowd the shoulder of someone climbing with their arms full.

What done looks like:
1. Every frame level
2. Hung from two points
3. Each one the same vertical distance above the tread nose below it
4. So the gallery climbs on the stair's diagonal rather than fighting it. No sawtooth hanger

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success wall and display zone.
